title: Can India Capitalise On The AI Homecoming?
script:
Indian engineers are leaving Silicon Valley roles to build AI in India.
For years, this talent fueled global tech companies and research labs abroad.
Now, the Indian AI ecosystem is shifting toward building local proprietary models.
Domestic startups are raising capital to solve India-specific enterprise challenges.
Investors are betting on deep tech instead of traditional service-based models.
Founders want to transform the country from a service provider into a product hub.
Can India dominate the next wave of global AI development?
